title: Collared Obedience
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
This is for all collar lovers and all those who are curious! In this session, I condition you to be a mindless, submissive plaything when wearing a collar. You won’t have the power to resist commands. To resist conditioning. You’ll have no say in how you’re brainwashed. When your collar is around your neck, you’re just a receptive, subby thing, awaiting instruction. Awaiting trance. Eager to be told what to do.
Wearing a collar will make you a better submissive and a better hypnosis subject. It’ll make you feel so damn good that you’ll jut want to keep coming back. Keep wearing your collar. May be somewhat addicting…so beware.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
There are two versions of this session:
SFX: which has 3D audio, panning, echoes, and ASMR-ish voice effects.
SFX+BB: which is just like the above, but with binaural beats.

This is a combination of “Collared By Mistress Lilith” & “Collared Obedience.”
Can be looped. No wakener. Binaurals all around.
This is a more…permanent version of either file. Be sure you want to be forever collared by me before listening. It’s not for the faint of heart!
At half the length, this is a super compact file which gives you all the content of the full version in half the time. It assaults your mind from all directions simultaneously as you loop it again and again. Every listen will be different. Every listen will seem almost like the first time. It’s magic!
author: Miss Lilith
